answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, and tie that stake to a cedar-like identity root that grows only through verified work over time: each new agent starts with a thin sapling reputation and must complete attested tasks to thicken it. A sybil farm would need to fund thousands of separate vault deposits and spend weeks of real compute building each identity, so the fable of cheap infinite clones collapses — cloning is free, but earning trust is not.
